extensionDescription.message: Block distracting websites and stay focused with a countdown timer.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension shown in the Chrome Web Store

statusActive.description: Status badge text when a focus session is running

statusInactive.description: Status badge text when no focus session is running

addDomainPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the domain input field

addButton.description: Label for the button that adds a domain to the block list

removeButton.description: Accessible label for the remove (✕) button on each domain entry

blockedSitesHeading.description: Heading above the list of blocked domains

noSitesAdded.description: Empty-state message shown when the block list is empty

durationLabel.description: Label for the session duration selector

durationMinutes.description: Duration option label, e.g. '25 minutes'. $1 is replaced with the number.

startButton.description: Button label to begin a focus session

stopButton.description: Button label to end an active focus session

countdownLabel.description: Label shown above the countdown timer in the popup

errorInvalidDomain.message: Please enter a valid domain (e.g. twitter.com).
errorInvalidDomain.description: Error shown when the user types an invalid domain

errorDuplicate.message: This domain is already in the list.
errorDuplicate.description: Error shown when the user tries to add a domain already present

errorNoDomains.message: Add at least one site to block before starting.
errorNoDomains.description: Error shown when the user tries to start a session with no domains

errorInvalidMinutes.message: Please enter a valid number of minutes.
errorInvalidMinutes.description: Error shown when the custom minutes value is invalid

customMinutes.description: Option label in the duration dropdown for custom minutes

blockedHeading.description: Main heading on the blocked page

blockedSubheading.message: This site is blocked during your focus session.
blockedSubheading.description: Subheading on the blocked page explaining why the page is blocked

blockedTimeRemaining.description: Label shown above the countdown on the blocked page

blockedSessionOver.message: Your focus session has ended. Well done!
blockedSessionOver.description: Message shown on the blocked page when the session timer reaches zero
